description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitution Reforms - Guidelines made under Section 3 Conferring the Honour of Senior Instructing Attorney at Law Act, No. 26 of 2023
reasoning: This gazette contains guidelines made by the Minister of Justice under the Conferring the Honour of Senior Instructing Attorneys-at-Law Act, No. 26 of 2023. It establishes regulatory criteria and procedures for conferring a professional honor, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or structural adjustments. The content focuses on creating a legal framework for professional recognition rather than appointing individuals or restructuring government entities.
